arguments: SPECIAL: LAND OF THE DRAGONS II

commands.name: stringn
arguments: The trophy hunters are looking for prey again! Up to 6 teams can put their skills to the test while they hunt the wolf creatures!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Your mission is to hunt down the dangerous wolf creatures of this rocky labyrinth. You should make sure you have equipped enough soldiers before the hunt begins!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: If you find a raincow, capture it with your scout. If you pay it the required food tribute, it will place its powers at your disposal!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Cloudy but bright, with intermittent rainy spells!
